Container.Name: lsyncd-webui-backup
Container.Overview: Backup server side of lsyncd-webui. A small SSH server that only accepts the main server's key and writes the mirror into the backup folder.

Config.Name: Backup folder
Config.Description: Where the copy of the main server is stored.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Host key of this backup server.

Config.Name: Main server key
Config.Description: Public key from the main server's web UI (Settings, SSH key). Starts with ssh-ed25519.

Config.Name: SSH port
Config.Description: Port the main server connects to (host network).

Config.Name: Port without encryption
Config.Description: For transfers without SSH encryption, used when the main server's Encryption setting is None. Only use that over a VPN. Accepts only the main server's key. 0 turns it off.
